author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
If you try to understand the code generated by AI, you are doing it wrong, you got it backwards

You should have envisioned the code AI supposed to generate, then make AI generates exactly what you have in your mind.

It is like a magician, the more vivid image you have on the outcome, the more powerful the magic when casted.

author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

replies.text:
Job K Joseph do you manually patch a compiled binary?

Code is the new binary

Manual edit of code is the equivalent of doing ECO by rewiring the gates, what is the point?   Update the RTL, resynthize, then let the tool figure how to clip the wires at metal layer
